sources.entry: Thumbor - A smart imaging service and enables on-demand cropping, resizing, applying filters and optimizing images. (Source Code) MIT Python/Docker
thumbor - A smart imaging service. It enables on-demand crop, resizing and flipping of images.

summary.one_liner: thumbor is an HTTP imaging service that crops, resizes, filters and optimizes images on demand via URL path parameters.
summary.what_it_does: thumbor serves images over HTTP and generates variants on demand by changing path parameters in the URL, such as a 300x200 crop of a source image. It supports smart cropping that uses face and feature detection (for example glasses or interesting points) to avoid cutting off heads. It supports common image formats and can read originals from many storages, including local disk, AWS S3, Rackspace and Ceph. It uses caching to speed up repeated requests and is designed to be extended with custom filters, storages, engines and loaders. Installation is available via pip (with optional OpenCV or all-dependency extras), a Debian/Ubuntu package, or an official Docker image on GitHub Container Registry.
use_cases: applying filters to images via URL
notable: URL path parameters define each image variant, so no pre-generated copies are needed
AI-based smart cropping using face and feature detection
Many storage backends including AWS S3, Rackspace and Ceph
Built-in thumbor-doctor diagnostic command for troubleshooting
Companion awesome-thumbor list of filters, storages, engines and loaders
caveats: Some features need optional extras such as OpenCV or the all-dependencies install
Troubleshooting may require the thumbor-doctor tool and a config file
README does not state platform limits beyond the Debian/Ubuntu and Docker options
